instructions.step1: Run: npx expo start --web  (or start the Expo workflow in Replit)
instructions.step2: Open browser dev tools → set viewport to each device size below
instructions.step3: Navigate to each listed screen and capture a screenshot
instructions.step5: Upload to App Store Connect (iOS) and Google Play Console (Android) under the relevant metadata section
